description: This file declares interfaces and classes related to cryptographic cipher implementations, including encryption and decryption methods, for different vault types within a security framework.

classes.name: Cipher
classes.description: Implements cryptographic cipher operations using a specified vault and algorithm.

classes.name: CipherNetflix
classes.description: Implements cipher operations using Netflix-specific vaults and handles.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data using specified IV and key.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data using specified IV and key.

methods.name: Operation
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption based on the 'encrypt' flag.

methods.name: AESCipher
methods.description: Returns AES cipher configuration for the given mode.
